Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide

This document is meant to help you migrate your application to Spring Boot 3.0.

Before You Start

Upgrade to the Latest 2.7.x Version

Before you start, upgrade to the latest 2.7.x release.

Upgrade to Spring Boot 3

Jakarta EE

Spring Boot 3.0 has upgraded to the version that is included in Jakarta EE 10.

  • Servlet 6.0

  • JPA 3.1

<dependency>
	<artifactId>spring-boot-properties-migrator</artifactId>
</dependency>
# commentaire
runtimeOnly("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-properties-migrator")

Jakarta EE Servlet

Replace javax.servlet with jakarta.servlet.

Web Application Changes

Trailing slash matching is now disabled by default.
